mapper.insert: insert into dim_channel(project_id, product_id, product_name, channel_id, channel_name, pkg) select p.project_type project_id, p.id product_id, p.project_name product_name, c.channel channel_id, c.channel_name, c.pkg from ods_sys_channel c left join ods_sys_project p on (c.project_id = p.id)
mapper.select: select id, project_id, product_id, product_name, channel_id, channel_name, pkg from dim_channel
